	mod1440_records_handle = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "mod1440_records_handle"
		parent_window_token = top_bar

		visible = {
			always = yes
		}

		effects = {
			rec_toggle_click = {
				mod1440_ev_init = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 } }
					mod1440_rec_close = yes
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 }
					mod1440_rec_show = yes
				}
			}
		}

		triggers = {
			rec_badge_bg_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_rec_new > 0 }
			}
			rec_badge_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_rec_new > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_new_war > 0 } }
			}
			rec_badge_war_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_rec_new > 0 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_rec_new_war > 0 }
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
		}
	}

	mod1440_state_card = {
		context_type = selected_state_context
		window_name = "mod1440_state_card"
		parent_window_token = selected_state_view

		visible = {
			is_controlled_by = ROOT
		}

		properties = {
			sc_flag = {
				image = "[?mod1440_sr_from.GetFlag]"
			}
		}

		effects = {
			sc_cite_click = {
				set_temp_variable = { hn_n = 0 }
				every_state_division = {
					limit = { OWNER = { tag = ROOT } }
					add_history_entry = {
						key = mod1440_hn_cited
						subject = "Citation"
						allow = yes
					}
					add_to_temp_variable = { hn_n = 1 }
				}
				set_variable = { mod1440_sr_cited = hn_n }
				set_variable = { mod1440_sr_cited_day = global.num_days }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { hn_n > 0 } }
					add_to_variable = { mod1440_sr_cites = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_cited }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 20 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_a = THIS }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_n = hn_n }
					ROOT = {
						mod1440_tr_add = yes
						add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_count = hn_n }
						add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_cite_n = hn_n }
						set_variable = { mod1440_hn_last_s = PREV }
						set_variable = { mod1440_hn_last_d = global.date }
						set_variable = { mod1440_hn_has_last = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			sc_its_lines_click = {
				ROOT = {
					set_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 7 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_wd_state = PREV }
					set_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 0 }
					clear_array = mod1440_wd_back
					set_variable = { mod1440_wd_from = 0 }
					mod1440_ev_init = yes
					set_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 }
					mod1440_rec_show = yes
				}
			}
		}

		triggers = {
			sc_lines_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_lines > 1 }
			}
			sc_lines_1_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_lines = 1 }
			}
			sc_flag_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_day > 0 }
			}
			sc_taken_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_day > 0 }
				NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_sr_how = 2 } }
			}
			sc_received_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_day > 0 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_how = 2 }
			}
			sc_treaty_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_day > 0 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_how = 2 }
			}
			sc_untaken_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_day < 1 }
			}
			sc_cite_visible = {
				has_dlc = "By Blood Alone"
			}
			sc_its_lines_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_lines > 0 }
			}
			sc_cited_visible = {
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_cited_day = global.num_days }
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_cited > 0 }
			}
			sc_cites_visible = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_sr_cited_day = global.num_days } }
				check_variable = { mod1440_sr_cites > 0 }
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
		}
	}
	mod1440_state_card_by = {
		context_type = selected_state_context
		window_name = "mod1440_state_card_by"
		parent_window_token = selected_state_view

		visible = {
			is_controlled_by = ROOT
			check_variable = { mod1440_sr_day > 0 }
			check_variable = { mod1440_sr_has_by = 1 }
		}

		properties = {
			sc_by_face = {
				image = "[?mod1440_sr_by_p.GetTokenKey]"
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = {
			always = no
		}
	}
